BPR is a volunteer-run rescue, not a shelter. Our animals stay in foster homes, boarding facilities, and veterinary clinics while they wait for suitable homes.

fields.section_subtitle: Please read the information below and confirm the three required agreements.

fields.field_label: Information
fields.variations:
Important Information Before Adoption

  • Submitting this form does not guarantee adoption. Placement decisions are based on the animal’s welfare and suitability.
  • Bubbles Pet Rescue may request an interview, animal meeting, reference check, and home or video home check.
  • Rescue animals may need time, patience, training, and professional support while settling in.
  • An adopted animal must not be sold, abandoned, transferred, or independently rehomed. Contact Bubbles first if circumstances change.
  • Known medical needs, adoption fees, and any trial-period terms will be explained before placement.

fields.field_label: Care and Financial Commitment
fields.consent_description: I agree to provide safe housing, appropriate food, exercise and enrichment, routine and emergency veterinary care, training or behavioural support, and the associated costs throughout the animal’s life.
fields.required_message: Please confirm this statement to continue.

fields.field_label: Return and Rehoming Policy
fields.consent_description: I agree to contact Bubbles Pet Rescue before surrendering, transferring, selling, abandoning, or independently rehoming the animal.
fields.required_message: Please confirm this statement to continue.

fields.field_label: Declaration, Privacy, and Screening
fields.consent_description: I confirm that I am 18 years old or older and authorised to submit this application, that the information provided is accurate, and I consent to Bubbles Pet Rescue using it for adoption screening, reference checks, home or video checks, placement decisions, follow-up, and related rescue administration.
fields.required_message: Please confirm this statement to continue.

notifications.email-subject: We received your Bubbles Pet Rescue adoption application
notifications.email-editor:
Thank you for applying to adopt from Bubbles Pet Rescue.

Our volunteer team reviews every application carefully. We will usually contact suitable applicants within one to three days, although reviews can occasionally take up to a week.

Submitting an application does not guarantee adoption. We will contact you if we need further information or would like to arrange an interview, meeting, or home check.

You may follow up by WhatsApp on +971 50 808 3083.

Thank you for choosing adoption.
